description_en: Kisi Phalcā is a ground floor Phalcā with three bays located within the Byanjankar Capāḥ building. The structure is exceptionally narrow in size. It was dismantled some time around 1997 with the support of the German Technological Cooperation (GTZ-udle). The Capāḥ is used by the Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti and severalguthis, whereas the first floor is used by the Byanjankar Sīguthi.
description_ne: च्यासल चोकबाट ईशान कोणमा रहेको साँढे दुई तला भएको च्यासल चिधा चपाःको पश्चिपट्टिको पिँढीको रूपमा रहेको किसि फल्चा ज्यादै साँघुरो छ र यसमा तीनवटा कवल रहेका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Rebuilt

historical_events.event_description: Under the supervision of Viśva, a family of Vyanjankars of Cheri Yantāgṛha of Ombahāl renovated Kisi Phalcā. They were appointed as the monument's caretakers.Transliteration of the stone inscription of thePhalcā (provisionally by N. Sharma)(svasti sign) śreyostu || samvat 826 āṣāḍha śukla pa-n͂camyāntithau uttarā phālguṇī nakṣatre parighayoge bṛhaspati vāsare thva kunhu vaṃbāhāra cheriyantāgṛha byan͂janakāla viśva thaṃkādi pramukha-mi thava bhochi samuhasana kṣaca dasyaṃ coṃgva capāḍa dādvāpva mokasa thva bhochi samuhasana jīrṇo-ddhāra yāṅa dayakaṃ pratisthā yāṅā juro thva ca-pāḍasaṃ chagu julasanāṃ mālako thva bhochi sa-muhasa odhina jura || meva sunānuṃ kaciṃga-la thanan͂asāṃ  mado juro chetrisa ju-ko bhālana pāli choyake do  talesa joko-yā thva bhochiyā ādhina juro || bhālana ma-ko palatra thva bhochina lhoṅā juro sunānuṃkacigala thaṅasā gobrāhmaṇādi paṃca tra-hā pātaka lākahu juro bhinakalasā u-trotra kuro sāki(kṣi) rāmakṛṣṇa bhāro dṛṣṭa||  yathāśāyukta phalamastu śubha ||Rough Translation of the stone inscription of the Phalcā (by N. Sharma):[Svasti sign].  On the 5th day of the bright half of the Lunar month of Āṣāḍha in NS 826 (1706 CE) in the constellation of Uttarā Phālgunī, in the combination of Parigha, on Thursday, on this day, the whole family of Vyanjankars of Cheri Yantāgṛha of Ombahāl led by Viśva, thethakāli(senior person and guthi member) renovated thecapāḥwhich was here from earlier times.  Whatever is necessary for thecapāḥ, the responsibility [to fulfill this] goes to the family. Nobody else is allowed to create trouble. The upper part of thecapāḥshall be under the control of the family. If anybody else creates problems, s/he shall get five kinds of great sins such as killing a cow or a Brahman etc. If anybody else does better s/he shall get prosperity.  Witness is Rāmakṛṣṇa Bhāro. May all be well.
